description:
Read the order limits for a portfolio.

    Call this before add_transaction on a buy, sell, short, or cover.
    The rules say which assets are allowed and how large an order may be.
    This tool cannot change the rules.

    Args:
        portfolio_id: The portfolio UUID

strategy_id.description: Strategy this call belongs to. UUID from list_strategies. The card this call writes keeps that id. Omit when the call is not part of a strategy.
strategy_id.title: Strategy Id

name: get_portfolio_rules
title: Get portfolio rules
